description: This file contains validation functions for Kubernetes list types, specifically for ensuring uniqueness and correctness of list elements with 'map' and 'set' list types in the Kubernetes API schema.

methods.name: ValidateListSetsAndMaps
methods.description: Validates that list elements with 'map' or 'set' types fulfill uniqueness constraints.

methods.name: validationListSetAndMaps
methods.description: Dispatches validation based on the type of list element, either array or map.

methods.name: validateListSetsAndMapsArray
methods.description: Validates array elements for 'set' or 'map' list types, including recursive validation.

methods.name: validateListSet
methods.description: Checks for duplicate scalar or compound items in a list, returning indices of non-unique items.

methods.name: validateListMap
methods.description: Validates list of maps for uniqueness based on specified key fields, ensuring objects are valid and unique.
